recognize_zh: 兒童骨髓切片中造血細胞與脂肪細胞交錯，中央有一群成熟中的紅血球系前驅細胞島（深色小圓核），左側可見小型、雙核的巨核細胞，另有少量含鐵血黃素沉積；此紅系島加上小型異常巨核細胞的組合，符合 RCC。
features: Hematopoietic tissue interspersed with numerous adipocytes
Central erythroid island of maturing normoblasts with dark round nuclei
Small megakaryocytes, including one with two separate round nuclei
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows hematopoietic tissue interspersed with adipocytes, containing a prominent erythroid island of maturing normoblasts. Megakaryocytes are small, and one shows two widely separated round nuclei. Granulopoiesis is relatively sparse, and scattered hemosiderin deposits are present. Overall cellularity cannot be judged from this high-power field alone. In a child with persistent cytopenias, the patchy erythroid islands and small megakaryocytes are suggestive of refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia lacks erythroid islands with left-shifted maturation and shows no megakaryocytic dysplasia.
Morphology overlaps, so chromosome breakage and germline genetic studies are needed.
MDS-EB requires increased blasts (≥5% in marrow), which are not evident in this field and should be assessed with CD34 staining.
